releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.25 — fixes the launch crash. Upgrading from an older install could leave one saved setting in the old format, and reading it closed the app immediately; the app now reads every stored value safely whatever format it is in. Nothing to sign in again, no data lost. Also included: the crash screen with a Copy button, compressed photos with thumbnails, an instant chat list, private media, and no in-app server option.
